name: Person Registration
description: Register an applicant's personal details and apply for a product from the public catalogue. Adults requesting cheap items (price < 100) are auto-approved by a DMN rule; everyone else is routed to a civil-servant review queue.

variables.title: personRegistration start-time variables
variables.description: Variables collected from the applicant. The engine sets `initiator` from the authenticated user automatically; never include it in start_process input.

age.description: Applicant's age in years. Affects the auto-approval branch (adults only).

objectId.description: Product ID from the public catalogue at https://api.restful-api.dev/objects. The engine fetches the product price server-side via http-connector and feeds it to the auto-approval DMN.

userTasks.name: Submit personal details
userTasks.description: The applicant confirms (or corrects) their personal details and product choice. This is the same shape as the start variables — when start_process pre-fills them, completing this task with the identical values just advances the process.

objectId.description: Product ID from the public catalogue.

userTasks.name: Review application
userTasks.description: The civil servant accepts the application or sends it back to the applicant with a reason. A non-interrupting timer fires every two minutes while this task is open and sends a reminder email via Mailpit. If sent back, the process loops to the applicant's personal-details task.

decision.description: approve = end the process as approved. sendback = email the applicant with the reason and loop back to the personal-details task.

sendBackReason.description: Required when decision = sendback. The applicant sees this as a banner above the personal-details form on re-entry.
